scripts.dev: npm run build -w @applyflow/contracts && concurrently --raw --kill-others --names contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @applyflow/contracts" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @applyflow/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build -w @applyflow/contracts && npm run build -w @applyflow/api && npm run build -w @applyflow/web
